query:
-- Update USF 2021 Season with complete creative teams and correct dates
UPDATE news 
SET blocks = '[
  {"type":"text","content":"Brandon PT Davis served as Assistant Scenic Designer for the 2021 Utah Shakespeare Festival season, providing drafting and 3D modeling support for two productions designed by Jo Winiarski. This season marked the beginning of a five-year collaboration with the festival that would span 12 productions through 2025."},
  {"type":"header","content":"The Pirates of Penzance"},
  {"type":"text","content":"Gilbert and Sullivan''s beloved comic opera sailed into Cedar City with a vibrant production directed by Cassie Abate. The scenic design featured a colorful ship deck setting that captured the whimsical spirit of the Pirate King and his bumbling crew."},
  {"type":"image","url":"https://cdn.manus.space/prod-user-files/mdq-scenic-model-detail.jpeg","caption":"Production photo from The Pirates of Penzance at Utah Shakespeare Festival, showcasing Jo Winiarski''s scenic design. Photo courtesy of Utah Shakespeare Festival."},
  {"type":"header","content":"Ragtime"},
  {"type":"text","content":"This powerful musical, directed by Brian Vaughn, brought together three distinct American communities at the turn of the 20th century. The multi-level scenic design supported the epic storytelling and large ensemble cast."},
  {"type":"team","title":"The Pirates of Penzance Creative Team","members":[{"name":"Cassie Abate","role":"Director"},{"name":"Jo Winiarski","role":"Scenic Designer"},{"name":"Brandon PT Davis","role":"Assistant Scenic Designer"},{"name":"William C. Kirkham","role":"Lighting Designer"},{"name":"Joe Payne","role":"Sound Designer"},{"name":"Bill Black","role":"Costume Designer"},{"name":"Karl Hugh","role":"Choreographer"}]},
  {"type":"team","title":"Ragtime Creative Team","members":[{"name":"Brian Vaughn","role":"Director"},{"name":"Jo Winiarski","role":"Scenic Designer"},{"name":"Brandon PT Davis","role":"Assistant Scenic Designer"},{"name":"Joe Payne","role":"Sound Designer"},{"name":"Bill Black","role":"Costume Designer"}]},
  {"type":"link","url":"https://www.bard.org","text":"Visit Utah Shakespeare Festival"}
]',
date = '2021-10-09'
WHERE slug = 'utah-shakespeare-festival-2021-season';

-- Update USF 2022 Season
UPDATE news
SET blocks = '[
  {"type":"text","content":"Brandon PT Davis returned to the Utah Shakespeare Festival for the 2022 season as Assistant Scenic Designer, working on-site in Cedar City to support three productions designed by Jo Winiarski. Being on-site allowed for direct participation in the technical rehearsal process and collaboration with the full production team."},
  {"type":"header","content":"Trouble in Mind"},
  {"type":"text","content":"Alice Childress''s groundbreaking 1955 play about a Black actress confronting racism in the theater received a powerful production directed by Cassie Abate. The scenic design created both the rehearsal space and the play-within-a-play setting."},
  {"type":"image","url":"https://cdn.manus.space/prod-user-files/usf-2022-trouble-in-mind.jpeg","caption":"Production photo from Trouble in Mind at Utah Shakespeare Festival. Photo courtesy of Utah Shakespeare Festival."},
  {"type":"header","content":"Clue: On Stage"},
  {"type":"text","content":"The beloved board game came to life in this hilarious whodunit directed by J.R. Sullivan. The iconic mansion setting with its multiple rooms provided the perfect backdrop for murder, mystery, and mayhem."},
  {"type":"header","content":"The Sound of Music"},
  {"type":"text","content":"Rodgers and Hammerstein''s timeless musical, directed by Brian Vaughn, filled the Randall L. Jones Theatre with the hills alive with music. The scenic design captured both the warmth of the Von Trapp family home and the majesty of the Austrian Alps."},
  {"type":"team","title":"Trouble in Mind Creative Team","members":[{"name":"Cassie Abate","role":"Director"},{"name":"Jo Winiarski","role":"Scenic Designer"},{"name":"Brandon PT Davis","role":"Assistant Scenic Designer"},{"name":"Robert Aguilar","role":"Lighting Designer"},{"name":"Joe Payne","role":"Sound Designer"},{"name":"Bill Black","role":"Costume Designer"}]},
  {"type":"team","title":"Clue: On Stage Creative Team","members":[{"name":"J.R. Sullivan","role":"Director"},{"name":"Jo Winiarski","role":"Scenic Designer"},{"name":"Brandon PT Davis","role":"Assistant Scenic Designer"},{"name":"Robert Aguilar","role":"Lighting Designer"},{"name":"Joe Payne","role":"Sound Designer"},{"name":"Bill Black","role":"Costume Designer"}]},
  {"type":"team","title":"The Sound of Music Creative Team","members":[{"name":"Brian Vaughn","role":"Director"},{"name":"Jo Winiarski","role":"Scenic Designer"},{"name":"Brandon PT Davis","role":"Assistant Scenic Designer"},{"name":"Robert Aguilar","role":"Lighting Designer"},{"name":"Joe Payne","role":"Sound Designer"},{"name":"Bill Black","role":"Costume Designer"},{"name":"Cassie Abate","role":"Choreographer"}]},
  {"type":"link","url":"https://www.bard.org","text":"Visit Utah Shakespeare Festival"}
]',
date = '2022-10-08'
WHERE slug = 'utah-shakespeare-festival-2022-season';

-- Update USF 2023 Season
UPDATE news
SET blocks = '[
  {"type":"text","content":"The 2023 season at Utah Shakespeare Festival saw Brandon PT Davis continue as Assistant Scenic Designer for two Shakespeare productions designed by Jo Winiarski, providing drafting and 3D modeling support for these classic works."},
  {"type":"header","content":"Romeo and Juliet"},
  {"type":"text","content":"Shakespeare''s timeless tragedy of star-crossed lovers received a fresh interpretation directed by Rodney Lizcano. The scenic design created the world of Verona where love and violence collide."},
  {"type":"image","url":"https://cdn.manus.space/prod-user-files/usf-2023-romeo-juliet.jpeg","caption":"Production photo from Romeo and Juliet at Utah Shakespeare Festival. Photo courtesy of Utah Shakespeare Festival."},
  {"type":"header","content":"A Midsummer Night''s Dream"},
  {"type":"text","content":"Shakespeare''s magical comedy, directed by Brian Vaughn, transported audiences to the enchanted forest where fairies, lovers, and mechanicals create delightful chaos. The scenic design captured the wonder and whimsy of the fairy realm."},
  {"type":"team","title":"Romeo and Juliet Creative Team","members":[{"name":"Rodney Lizcano","role":"Director"},{"name":"Jo Winiarski","role":"Scenic Designer"},{"name":"Brandon PT Davis","role":"Assistant Scenic Designer"},{"name":"Robert Aguilar","role":"Lighting Designer"},{"name":"Joe Payne","role":"Sound Designer"},{"name":"Bill Black","role":"Costume Designer"}]},
  {"type":"team","title":"A Midsummer Night''s Dream Creative Team","members":[{"name":"Brian Vaughn","role":"Director"},{"name":"Jo Winiarski","role":"Scenic Designer"},{"name":"Brandon PT Davis","role":"Assistant Scenic Designer"},{"name":"Robert Aguilar","role":"Lighting Designer"},{"name":"Joe Payne","role":"Sound Designer"},{"name":"Bill Black","role":"Costume Designer"}]},
  {"type":"link","url":"https://www.bard.org","text":"Visit Utah Shakespeare Festival"}
]',
date = '2023-09-09'
WHERE slug = 'utah-shakespeare-festival-2023-season';

-- Update USF 2024 Season
UPDATE news
SET blocks = '[
  {"type":"text","content":"Brandon PT Davis returned for the 2024 Utah Shakespeare Festival season as Assistant Scenic Designer, supporting two powerful productions designed by Jo Winiarski that explored themes of legacy, ambition, and scientific discovery."},
  {"type":"header","content":"The Mountaintop"},
  {"type":"text","content":"Katori Hall''s intimate two-character play, directed by Cameron Knight, imagined the last night of Dr. Martin Luther King Jr.''s life. The motel room setting created a powerful space for this fictional encounter that explores the human side of an icon."},
  {"type":"image","url":"https://cdn.manus.space/prod-user-files/usf-2024-mountaintop.jpeg","caption":"Production photo from The Mountaintop at Utah Shakespeare Festival. Photo courtesy of Utah Shakespeare Festival."},
  {"type":"header","content":"Silent Sky"},
  {"type":"text","content":"Lauren Gunderson''s play about astronomer Henrietta Leavitt, directed by Melinda Pfundstein, celebrated female achievement in science. The scenic design supported the journey from earthbound constraints to cosmic discoveries, with projections enhancing the astronomical themes."},
  {"type":"team","title":"The Mountaintop Creative Team","members":[{"name":"Cameron Knight","role":"Director"},{"name":"Jo Winiarski","role":"Scenic Designer"},{"name":"Brandon PT Davis","role":"Assistant Scenic Designer"},{"name":"Jaymi Lee Smith","role":"Lighting Co-Designer"},{"name":"Tom Mays","role":"Lighting Co-Designer"},{"name":"Joe Payne","role":"Sound Designer/Original Music Composer"},{"name":"ien Denio","role":"Projections Designer"},{"name":"Jeffrey Lieder","role":"Costume Coordinator"}]},
  {"type":"team","title":"Silent Sky Creative Team","members":[{"name":"Melinda Pfundstein","role":"Director"},{"name":"Jo Winiarski","role":"Scenic Designer"},{"name":"Brandon PT Davis","role":"Assistant Scenic Designer"},{"name":"Jaymi Lee Smith","role":"Lighting Co-Designer"},{"name":"Tom Mays","role":"Lighting Co-Designer"},{"name":"Joe Payne","role":"Sound Designer"},{"name":"ien Denio","role":"Projections Designer"},{"name":"David Kay Mickelsen","role":"Costume Designer"}]},
  {"type":"link","url":"https://www.bard.org","text":"Visit Utah Shakespeare Festival"}
]',
date = '2024-10-05'
WHERE slug = 'utah-shakespeare-festival-2024-season';

-- Update USF 2025 Season
UPDATE news
SET blocks = '[
  {"type":"text","content":"The 2025 season marks Brandon PT Davis''s fifth consecutive year as Assistant Scenic Designer at Utah Shakespeare Festival, supporting three productions designed by Jo Winiarski. This milestone represents a significant ongoing collaboration spanning 12 productions from 2021 through 2025."},
  {"type":"header","content":"The Importance of Being Earnest"},
  {"type":"text","content":"Oscar Wilde''s sparkling comedy of manners, directed by Rodney Lizcano, brought Victorian wit and social satire to Cedar City. The elegant scenic design captured the refined world where trivial matters become matters of great importance."},
  {"type":"image","url":"https://cdn.manus.space/prod-user-files/usf-2025-earnest.jpeg","caption":"Production photo from The Importance of Being Earnest at Utah Shakespeare Festival. Photo courtesy of Utah Shakespeare Festival."},
  {"type":"header","content":"A Gentleman''s Guide to Love and Murder"},
  {"type":"text","content":"This Tony Award-winning musical comedy, directed by Amanda Berg Wilson, followed Monty Navarro''s darkly hilarious quest to inherit an earldom. The scenic design supported the rapid scene changes and multiple locations required for this fast-paced murder spree."},
  {"type":"header","content":"Steel Magnolias"},
  {"type":"text","content":"Robert Harling''s beloved play about friendship and resilience, directed by Melissa Maxwell, brought the warmth of Truvy''s beauty salon to life. The scenic design created an intimate Louisiana setting where these strong Southern women gather to support each other through life''s challenges."},
  {"type":"team","title":"The Importance of Being Earnest Creative Team","members":[{"name":"Rodney Lizcano","role":"Director"},{"name":"Jo Winiarski","role":"Scenic Designer"},{"name":"Brandon PT Davis","role":"Assistant Scenic Designer"},{"name":"Jessica Greenberg","role":"Lighting Designer"},{"name":"Scott O''Brien","role":"Sound Designer/Original Music Composer"},{"name":"Bill Black","role":"Costume Designer"}]},
  {"type":"team","title":"A Gentleman''s Guide to Love and Murder Creative Team","members":[{"name":"Amanda Berg Wilson","role":"Director"},{"name":"Brad Carroll","role":"Music Director"},{"name":"Diana Dresser","role":"Choreographer"},{"name":"Jo Winiarski","role":"Scenic Designer"},{"name":"Brandon PT Davis","role":"Assistant Scenic Designer"},{"name":"Jessica Greenberg","role":"Lighting Designer"},{"name":"Scott O''Brien","role":"Sound Designer/Original Music Composer"},{"name":"K.L. Alberts","role":"Costume Designer"}]},
  {"type":"team","title":"Steel Magnolias Creative Team","members":[{"name":"Melissa Maxwell","role":"Director"},{"name":"Jo Winiarski","role":"Scenic Designer"},{"name":"Brandon PT Davis","role":"Assistant Scenic Designer"},{"name":"Jessica Greenberg","role":"Lighting Designer"},{"name":"Scott O''Brien","role":"Sound Designer/Original Music Composer"},{"name":"Lauren Roark","role":"Costume Designer"}]},
  {"type":"link","url":"https://www.bard.org","text":"Visit Utah Shakespeare Festival"}
]',
date = '2025-10-04'
WHERE slug = 'utah-shakespeare-festival-2025-season';
